_meta.description: Per-km cost and emissions by vehicle class. A trip is the round trip site -> facility -> back (2 x one-way km). Wheelie bins are emptied on a shared collection round, so only a share of the trip is allocated to this customer. DESNZ and WARM waste factors already include a default collection leg, so only distance beyond included_km one way is added to CO2e (the cost side still charges every km).

units.distance_share: fraction of the round trip allocated to one lift

rows.name: Refuse collection vehicle (shared round)
rows.source: Cost: sample. Emissions: DESNZ 2026 full set, Delivery vehicles, HGV (all diesel), Rigid (>17 tonnes), average laden = 0.99773 kg CO2e/km
rows.notes: Cost per km is a sample value. The emission factor is sourced; mapping this vehicle class to rigid >17 t is our assumption.
